grammar.title: Hubungan waktu
grammar.explain: Indonesian combines productive meN-, ber-, di-, ter-, peN-, -kan and -i morphology with aspect particles and flexible topic structure. Active-passive choice tracks discourse perspective; formal and colloquial forms serve different settings without being interchangeable.
grammar.pattern: topic + aspect/modal material + voice-marked predicate + arguments and discourse framing

items: Saya memahami kekhawatiran Anda; oleh karena itu, saya mengusulkan jalan tengah.
Saya sedang membaca laporan ketika rekan saya mengirim data baru.
key: Indonesian combines productive meN-, ber-, di-, ter-, peN-, -kan and -i morphology with aspect particles and flexible topic structure. Active-passive choice tracks discourse perspective; formal and colloquial forms serve different settings without being interchangeable.
